rules: INSPIRE files are updated on the first Sunday of each month and contain data from the previous month.
The current INSPIRE files remain accessible until the following monthly release replaces them.
The current official download page states that the dataset was published on 5 July 2026.
The National Polygon Service contains the National Polygon, Title Descriptor and Title Number/UPRN Look Up datasets.
The National Polygon dataset contains more than 25 million registered titles.
The National Polygon dataset contains more than 28 million polygons.
Every freehold or leasehold title has at least one index polygon in the National Polygon dataset.
UPRNs in the lookup dataset are unique 12-digit identifiers created by local authorities and Ordnance Survey.
A title number and UPRN can only be linked where an AddressBase address relationship can be established.
Licensed delivery includes a full dataset, a change-only update and a validation file.
The Title Number and UPRN Look Up dataset does not have a change-only file.
NPD CSV files use comma-separated, double-quoted fields and UTF-8 encoding.
The full NPD delivery is split into files with a 2GB limit.
Exact current Barnet and Enfield GML hrefs, bytes and hashes remain unavailable to the current transport.
Current INSPIRE IDs and native-BNG containment remain unresolved for the three candidates.
The official title-boundary page reports 4,247,781 title-boundary entities.
The title-boundary collector last ran on 29 July 2026.
The title-boundary page reports new data last found on 29 July 2026.
The dataset describes Land Registry Index polygons as indicative positions and extents of registered property.
The service notes that some data was created by MHCLG and is intended to be replaced with authoritative sources.
The entity search endpoint supports one or more reference parameters.
Exact current title-boundary responses for references 52040420, 52213916 and 52213412 remain unavailable.
Exact current point-intersection responses for all three candidate coordinates remain unavailable.
Authoritative UPRN bindings for the three candidates remain unavailable.
The Coverage Metadata - Survey Data record is published under an open government licence.
The coverage-metadata record gives a creation date of 24 September 2023.
The coverage-metadata record gives a revision date of 24 September 2023.
The record exposes WMS, WFS and OGC API Features service links.
The official Features landing page links an OpenAPI definition, collection list and conformance declaration.
The 1m DTM coverage collection advertises a geographic extent from -7.116,49.84 to 2.118,55.886.
The collection exposes ten queryable properties including geometry.
The official HTML item view is paginated with a 50-record page.
The 1m composite metadata includes source records at both 0.5m and 1.0m resolution.
A metadata record can reference multiple polygon IDs for one tile.
An exact TQ2892 collection feature and survey dates remain unavailable through the current safe transport.
Exact candidate DTM pixel values are not supplied by the metadata Features service and remain unavailable.
OS Terrain 50 is maintained through an integrated three-to-five-year flying programme.
The product is updated annually in July.
OS Terrain 50 grid data is verified to 4m RMSE.
The product provides full coverage of Great Britain.
The product is based on the INSPIRE elevation specification.
GeoPackage and vector-tile supplies are each provided as a single national flat file.
A full national supply of OS Terrain 50 grid tiles is stated as 157MB compressed.
Tiled data is supplied using ZIP compression and is not encrypted.
OS Terrain 50 supplies per-tile XML metadata following the GEMINI metadata standard.
